synonyms: The Exiled Lady Travels to Another World in a Camper Van While Crafting
synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Hellper 2: Killberos
synopsis: Jang Dae-Ho, the infamous vice president of the Nine Snake Family gang overthrown after 'the purge', was disposing of dead assassins bodies in the ruins of the grand earthquake that struck the forsaken city of Kana when he found a starved and nameless orphan. Taking him under his wing and giving him the name "Gwangnam" would be the catalyst for a long and bloody revenge journey under which the name "Killberos" began. Thus, this is the dark story of Gwangnam's crime infested upbringing, riddled with the many street rivalries and gangs' power struggles that preceded the formation of the fence project and "Killberos", the guard tribe, as we know it before his passing.

title: Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
titleEnglish: Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
titleRomaji: Hell Mode: Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Haisettei no Isekai de Musou Suru - Hajimari no Shoukanshi
titleNative: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～ はじまりの召喚士
synopsis: Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a “Hell Mode”—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential. Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him. Allen works diligently to level himself up despite Hell Mode requiring vast amounts of experience between levels. In doing so, he hopes to uncover the secrets the Summoner class holds. All the while, he dedicates himself to freeing his new family from serfdom. (Source: J-Novel Club)
